notes.title: 🎉 100 Owners Joined! The Shop has a Minor Renovation🛠️
notes.content:
[h3]/[/h3][h2]Breaking News: Over 100 Owners!🎉[/h2][h3]\\[/h3][p]To thank you,  we've polished the shaved ice shop![/p][p]Please refer to the following patch notes for more details.[/p][p]We're looking forward to your Steam reviews!
[/p][h3]Patch Note[/h3][list][*][p]During Tutorial, added blinking animation to the 2 default recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Options Text and Auto speed preview now start with corresponding language[/p][/*][*][p]Refine the wording and grammar of the Japanese, Traditional Chinese dialogue[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for believing in [b]Yume Kakigori[/b] right from the start and stepping in as one of our very first shop owners.[/p][p]Because of you, we’ve been able to create a better shaved ice-making experience for the owners who joined later. Thank you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/fd5f434c4b03277833433f0449557708c943eafb.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795660/Yume_Kakigori/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Yume Kakigori has reached 🎉1000 wishlists🎉 thank you!!
notes.content:
[h3]Yume Kakigori has reached 1000 wishlists, thank you!![/h3]
[h3]We have prepared an update for the demo version which includes quality of life improvements and reduce the file size.[/h3]
[h3]We hope these small adjustments help improve the experience of the demo.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/da66ff152a0ca5db2215881e9f596de433ed739e.gif[/img]

[h3]Patch note:[/h3]

[b]added options menu, provides adjustment for:[/b]
[list]
[*] window mode
[*] resolution
[*] language
[*] skip option
[*] BGM volume
[*] SE volume
[*] text speed
[*] auto speed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/94c307bf155675f9ed82c9acfcd8142396276ae6.png[/img]
[b]added pause menu, for:[/b]
[list]
[*] save game
[*] load game
[*] options menu
[*] quit game
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/fafec65fd2b591f06aba749a92bcb2bb3bd9a56c.png[/img]
[b]some small adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] renew recipe tutorial effect.
[*] added effect on Keyword's image.
[*] small adjustment for grammar and wording.
[/list]
[b]file size optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Windows: 365MB --> 242MB
[*] macOS: 319MB -->269MB
[/list]

[h2]Please continue to support Yume Kakigori, thank you!![/h2]
